name: keep only the k best of each frontier
mechanism: expand a frontier level by level but after each level keep only the k best-scoring nodes and discard the rest

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Beam search' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms / Graph search: is a heuristic search algorithm that is an optimization of best-first search that reduces its memory requirement

fails_when: the optimum may be pruned; no completeness
